title: When the Yearbook Falls
author: Emrys Zhou
blurb: Astrid Thackeray, the new kid at a school built over something old, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
